label: SOFAR HYD 5-20KTL-3PH
status_note: Public community sources only; nothing verified on hardware. Covers the three-phase SOFAR HYD 5-20KTL-3PH hybrids on the G3 register map, identified by the serial-number prefix at holding 0x0445 (SP1, SP2, SH1) and the ZCS Azzurro 3PH HYD ZSS rebrands (ZP1, ZP2). The single-phase HYD 3-6K-ES and HYD 3-6K-EP (serials SM1E on the older map, SM2E/ZM2E on a G3-style map the community plugin reads like the three-phase one but that this profile does not assume), the grid-tied KTL/KTLX lines and inverters reached through the ZCS Connext cloud are not covered. Addresses are wire (PDU) addresses; for Sofar they equal the hexadecimal register addresses used by the vendor and the community maps (0x0608 = 1544), with no minus-one offset. Everything is a holding register (function 3). Control is limited to writing Energy Storage Mode 0x1110 = 0 (Self Use, the vendor default): forced charge/discharge needs Passive mode (0x1110 = 3) plus three 32-bit set-points 0x1187-0x118C written as one block, and Timing/Time-of-Use modes need start/end slots with 32-bit power and a commit register, none of which the engine can express (see docs/profiles/engine-gaps.md); grid charge, forced discharge, sell and standby therefore map to the neutral mode without power and their capabilities are false. The community docs say most writable parameters, Energy Storage Mode included, are stored in EEPROM (about 100000 write cycles), hence nvm. Live-test checklist: (1) serial prefix at 0x0445-0x044C (16 ASCII characters, high byte first, as the ha-solarman maps read it; the community notes put characters 17-20 at 0x0470-0x0471, not read here) and rated power at 0x06ED (0.1 kW units, documented only by the sofar-modbus library; older firmware may not have it); (2) 32-bit totals high word first (0x0686 PV, 0x068E bought, 0x0692 sold, 0.1 kWh) and the scales: powers at 0x0485/0x0488/0x04AF/0x0606 in 0.01 kW, PV total 0x05C4 in 0.1 kW (100 W resolution), battery voltage 0x0604 0.1 V, current 0x0605 0.01 A; (3) signs: battery power 0x0606 and current 0x0605 > 0 while charging, PCC power 0x0488 > 0 while exporting (all negated here), inverter output 0x0485 > 0 when delivering; PCC power and load 0x04AF need the meter/CT connected; only battery pack 1 (0x0604-0x0608) is read, further packs sit at a stride of 7 registers and are not summed; (4) unit id 1 through the LSW-3 Wi-Fi logger (Solarman V5, port 8899, needs the logger serial from discovery) or RS485 through a Modbus gateway; (5) write function 16 (solax_modbus, sofar-modbus and evcc all write 0x1110 with function 16; function 6 is untested); evcc reports a non-standard reply to its FC16 writes at 0x1110 and ignores it, which the engine would treat as a failed write; (6) the safe write is re-writing 0 to 0x1110 while it reads 0 (Self Use), then reading 0x1110 back; restore by writing back the value read before the test. Battery temperature limits are the generic defaults of the other profiles, not Sofar data. Not used for control until verified.

sources.what: Sofar G3/HYD-3PH definition: serial 0x0445-0x044C (characters 17-20 at 0x0470-0x0471), battery power 0x0606 and PCC power 0x0488 inverted to the usual sign convention, output power 0x0485 used as delivered power, PV power 0x05C4 x100 W, totals as high/low word pairs, Storage Control Mode select at 0x1110 (0 Self Use, 1 Time of Use, 2 Optimized Revenue, 3 Passive, 4 Peak Shaving, ...), timed program 0x1111-0x1119 with 32-bit powers and the set-program button 0x111F, passive set-points written as one 6-register block from 0x1187, export limitation 0x1023/0x1024 (x100 W), depth of discharge 0x104D, Home Assistant entity names; unique ids '<entry id>_<slugified name>_<platform>'

modbus.status_note: Community integration sources only. All registers are holding registers (function 3); the reference integrations write 0x1110 as a single register with function 16. The only write is Energy Storage Mode at 0x1110, which is readable at the same address, so the verify block reads it back. Re-writing 0 (Self Use) while 0x1110 reads 0 is the safe probe. evcc ignores a non-standard reply to its FC16 writes at 0x1110; if the logger or gateway returns such a reply the engine reports the write as failed even when the read-back shows the new value (first thing to check on a live unit; function 6 is an untested fallback). Solarman V5 through the LSW-3 Wi-Fi logger needs the logger serial from discovery; timeout 3 s and gap_ms 200 follow the other Solarman profile and are not taken from a Sofar source. modbus_rtu is RS485 through a TCP gateway (port 8899 is a guess at a common gateway default; use the gateway's own port). Entity mode: two integrations share the solarman domain. davidrapan/ha-solarman (unique ids '<entry id>_<name>_<platform>') already inverts battery and grid power to the usual signs and offers the Storage Control Mode select; StephanJoubert/home_assistant_solarman (unique ids '<name>_<logger serial>_<field>') keeps the vendor signs and has sensors only, so its battery power, grid power and total PV power are not matched and need the manual pick. solax_modbus with the Sofar plugin names unique ids '<hub name>_<key>'; a hub name containing '_' does not match these regexes. Only the select option 'Self Use' (the same string in both integrations) is used.
